name: archboard_workhorse
description: Work with your workhorse, the agent that does sustained work for this canvas. Called from a script, a tool resolves to one string of JSON holding its whole result: print it with text(result). It is not an object, and it has no content array.

tools.name: inspect_workhorse
tools.description: Read what the workhorse is doing now: whether a turn is running, what is waiting for it, and its recent progress. Returns at once.

tools.name: delegate_to_workhorse
tools.description: Give the workhorse one piece of sustained work, written in English with the conversation context it needs.

tools.name: manage_workhorse_queue
tools.description: See or change the requests waiting for the workhorse to finish what it is doing.

tools.name: steer_workhorse
tools.description: Add one short instruction, such as a correction, to the turn the workhorse is running now. Works only while a turn is running.
